shutdown.title: Scheduled server shutdown

unknown.title: Unknown Event
unknown.message:
The server has sent you a message that your client does not understand.
This message might mean there is a new version of Cockatrice available or this server is running a custom or pre-release version.

To update your client, reload this page.

idle.title: Idle Timeout
idle.message: You are about to be logged out due to inactivity.

promoted.title: Promotion
promoted.message: You have been promoted. Please log out and back in for changes to take effect.

warning.title: Warned
warning.message:
You have received a warning due to {reason}.
Please refrain from engaging in this activity or further actions may be taken against you. If you have any questions, please private message a moderator.

custom.message:
You have received the following message from the server.
(custom messages like these could be untranslated)
